01 · FRONT DOOR

Africa's AI trading terminal

Priced in every currency

VXC — an in-app utility credit earned by trading, learning and referring. Architected chain-ready to bridge to Ethereum (ERC-20) and Bitcoin. Not a security; a loyalty engine.

Coins that pay you back

Every purchase earns cashback in VXC, and coins auto-apply at checkout for up to 30% off — with branded receipts emailed on every confirmed payment.

An owner's view of the coin economy: issued, redeemed and circulating supply, USD liability, top holders, and manual grants or deductions with a full audit ledger.

Under the hood

Everything inside

A full-stack trading platform — real market data, an AI signal engine, payments, a rewards coin and a global storefront — shipping as one product.

  • Live market data

    Twelve Data primary with Alpha Vantage, Finnhub & Binance failover — forex, metals, crypto, indices, stocks.

  • AI signal engine

    0–10 confidence, A+/A/B/C grades, a Voltex Quality gate and an RL layer that learns from closed trades.

  • Top-Down strategy

    D1→1H and 4H→15M multi-timeframe reads that only fire when the bias and entry agree.

  • VoltexAI Pay

    Stripe + Flutterwave, one-time store checkout, emailed receipts, and Voltex Coin auto-applied.

  • Voltex Coin (VXC)

    Earn on signup, check-ins, cashback, referrals, journalling & lessons; spend at checkout; admin ledger.

  • Global reach

    8 languages incl. Arabic RTL, 21 currencies, 195-country signup with flags & dial codes.

  • Partner network

    Weltrade · Deriv · Exness · XM Global — commission-tracked, one-click onboarding.

  • Community

    Topic-scoped discussion under every signal and analysis, plus the global trader wall.
